newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Talibor/Talibid interbank rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Talibor/Talibid interbank rates mixed.

text.p: The weighted average rate for one-week money rose but one-month rates fell in the Estonian interbank market on Wednesday, the central bank said.
The bank was announcing the latest Tallinn interbank offered and bid rates (Talibor/Talibid), calculated once a week as an average of leading banks' rates.
The one-week rate rose by 0.07 percent to 4.77/3.77 percent, one-month fell by 0.01 percent to 6.33/5.33 and three-month money rose by 0.02 percent to 8.00/7.00.
"The rise was very slight and it seems that just one bank has adjusted their rates to match other banks," one trader said.
"This month is very quiet compared to last month. Last month most banks were caught short and needed money, this month most banks are seeking to lend," the trader said.
The next Talibor and Talibid rates will be released on 5 March.
